'''2010 US East Nationals Rick Zuchowski LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Rick Zuchowski]] at [[2010 US East Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Rick Zuchkowski
* '''Deck name:''' Pilkin's WYS
* '''Username:''' Pilkin
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
